4.141.d:
आपो हिष्टेत्युमायास्तु श्येनेति स्वामिनस्तथा ॥
विष्णोरिदं विष्णुरिति स्वमिच्छेति स्वयंभुवः ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
4.141.m: With 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' for Umā, with 'śyena' for the Lord [Skanda], / with 'idaṃ viṣṇur' for Viṣṇu, and with 'svam iccha' for the Self-born [Brahmā];

4.141.s:
indrādidevatānāṃ tu indrāya juhuyātpunaḥ ..
navā yamasyāyaṃ gauścetyevaṃ homaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 4.141.40 ..
4.141.d:
इन्द्रादिदेवतानां तु इन्द्राय जुहुयात्पुनः ॥
नवा यमस्यायं गौश्चेत्येवं होमः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 4.141.40 ॥
4.141.m: and for the deities beginning with Indra, one should offer [with the mantra] to Indra; / for Yama with 'navā' and 'ayaṃ gauḥ'—thus the oblation is proclaimed.

4.141.s:
kālasya brahmajajñānamiti maṃtraḥ praśasyate ..
citraguptasya vā jāta paurāṇikā vidurbudhāḥ .. 41 ..
4.141.d:
कालस्य ब्रह्मजज्ञानमिति मंत्रः प्रशस्यते ॥
चित्रगुप्तस्य वा जात पौराणिका विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 41 ॥
4.141.m: For Kāla the mantra 'brahma jajñānam' is praised; / for Citragupta, or with 'jāta,' as the wise scholars of the Purāṇas know.

4.141.s:
agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe iti vahnerudāhṛtaḥ ..
iṃdraṃ yamaṃ varuṇamityayaṃ maṃtraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. .. 42 ..
4.141.d:
अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे इति वह्नेरुदाहृतः ॥
इंद्रं यमं वरुणमित्ययं मंत्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ ॥ 42 ॥
4.141.m: For Agni 'agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe' is declared; / 'indraṃ yamaṃ varuṇam' is the mantra proclaimed [for the guardians of the directions].

4.141.s:
bhūmeḥ pṛthivyaṃtarikṣamiti vedeṣu paṭhyate ..
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣa iti viṣṇorudāhṛtaḥ .. 43 ..
4.141.d:
भूमेः पृथिव्यंतरिक्षमिति वेदेषु पठ्यते ॥
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुष इति विष्णोरुदाहृतः ॥ 43 ॥
4.141.m: For the Earth, 'pṛthivy antarikṣam' is recited in the Vedas; / 'sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ' is declared for Viṣṇu.

4.141.s:
varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ ..
brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ pātu te sadā .. 44 ..
4.141.d:
वरुणः पवनश्चैव धनाध्यक्षस्तथा शिवः ॥
ब्रह्मणा सहितः शेषो दिक्पालाः पातु ते सदा ॥ 44 ॥
4.141.m: May Varuṇa, Pavana, Dhanādhyakṣa [Kubera], and Śiva, / along with Brahmā, Śeṣa, and the guardians of the directions, protect you always.

4.141.s:
kīrtirlakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhāḥ puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā matiḥ ..
buddhirlajjā śāṃtipuṣṭī kāṃtistuṣṭiśca mātaraḥ ..45..
4.141.d:
कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्धृतिर्मेधाः पुष्टिः श्रद्धा क्रिया मतिः ॥
बुद्धिर्लज्जा शांतिपुष्टी कांतिस्तुष्टिश्च मातरः ॥45॥
4.141.m: Kīrti, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Medhā, Puṣṭi, Śraddhā, Kriyā, Mati, / Buddhi, Lajjā, Śānti, Tuṣṭi, Kānti, and the Mothers—

4.141.s:
etāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu dharmapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ ..
ādityaścandramā bhaumo budhajīvasitārkajāḥ ..46..
4.141.d:
एतास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु धर्मपत्न्यः समागताः ॥
आदित्यश्चन्द्रमा भौमो बुधजीवसितार्कजाः ॥46॥
4.141.m: assembled as the wives of Dharma, may these consecrate you. / The Sun, the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn;

4.141.s:
grahāstvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu rāhuḥ ketuśca tarpitāḥ ..
devadānavagaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ .. 47 ..
4.141.d:
ग्रहास्त्वामभिषिंचंतु राहुः केतुश्च तर्पिताः ॥
देवदानवगंधर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः ॥ 47 ॥
4.141.m: may the planets consecrate you, as well as Rāhu and Ketu when satisfied; / gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and serpents;

4.141.s:
ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca ..
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ .. .. 48 ..
4.141.d:
ऋषयो मनवो गावो देवमातर एव च ॥
देवपत्न्यो द्रुमा नागा दैत्याश्चाप्सरसां गणाः ॥ ॥ 48 ॥
4.141.m: sages, Manus, cows, and the mothers of the gods; / the wives of the gods, trees, nāgas, Daityas, and the hosts of apsarases;

4.141.s:
astrāṇi sarvaśastrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca ..
auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāśca ye .. 49 ..
4.141.d:
अस्त्राणि सर्वशस्त्राणि राजानो वाहनानि च ॥
औषधानि च रत्नानि कालस्यावयवाश्च ये ॥ 49 ॥
4.141.m: missiles, all weapons, kings, and mounts; / herbs, jewels, and the divisions of Time;

4.141.s:
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāstīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ ..
ete tvāmabhiṣiṃcaṃtu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye .. 4.141.50 ..
4.141.d:
सरितः सागराः शैलास्तीर्थानि जलदा नदाः ॥
एते त्वामभिषिंचंतु सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये ॥ 4.141.50 ॥
4.141.m: rivers, oceans, mountains, sacred fords, clouds, and streams— / may these consecrate you for the accomplishment of all desires and purposes.

4.141.s:
tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ ..
sarvagandhasamāyuktaḥ snātaḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..51..
4.141.d:
ततः शुक्लांबरधरः शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनः ॥
सर्वगन्धसमायुक्तः स्नातः श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥51॥
4.141.m: Then, clad in white garments, anointed with white unguents, / endowed with all perfumes, bathed, and filled with faith,

4.141.s:
yajamānaḥ sapatnīkānsiddhidāṃstānsamāhitān ..
dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena pūjayedgatavismayaḥ .. 52 ..
4.141.d:
यजमानः सपत्नीकान्सिद्धिदांस्तान्समाहितान् ॥
दक्षिणाभिः प्रयत्नेन पूजयेद्गतविस्मयः ॥ 52 ॥
4.141.m: the patron of the sacrifice, free from arrogance, should diligently honour / [the priests] who grant success, composed in mind, together with their wives, with priestly gifts.

4.141.s:
sūryāya kapilāṃ dhenuṃ dadyācchaṃkhaṃ tathendave ..
raktaṃ dhuraṃdharaṃ dadyādbhaumāya kakudādhikam .. 53 ..
4.141.d:
सूर्याय कपिलां धेनुं दद्याच्छंखं तथेन्दवे ॥
रक्तं धुरंधरं दद्याद्भौमाय ककुदाधिकम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.141.m: To the Sun he should give a tawny cow; likewise a conch to the Moon; / to Mars he should give a red draught-ox with a large hump;

4.141.s:
budhāya jātarūpaṃ ca gurave pītavāsasī ..
śvetāśvaṃ daityagurave kṛṣṇāṃgāmarkasūnave .. 54 ..
4.141.d:
बुधाय जातरूपं च गुरवे पीतवाससी ॥
श्वेताश्वं दैत्यगुरवे कृष्णांगामर्कसूनवे ॥ 54 ॥
4.141.m: gold to Mercury; two yellow garments to Jupiter; / a white horse to the guru of the Daityas [Venus]; and black cows to the son of Arka [Saturn].

4.141.s:
āyasaṃ rāhave dadyātketave cchāgamuttamam ..
suvarṇena samā kāryā yajamānena dakṣiṇā .. 55..
4.141.d:
आयसं राहवे दद्यात्केतवे च्छागमुत्तमम् ॥
सुवर्णेन समा कार्या यजमानेन दक्षिणा ॥ 55॥
4.141.m: To Rāhu he should give iron; to Ketu an excellent he-goat; / the patron of the sacrifice should make the priestly gift equivalent in value to gold.

4.141.s:
sarveṣāmathavā dadyādgururvā yena tuṣyati ..
sumaṃtreṇa pradātavyāḥ sarvāḥ sarvārthadakṣiṇāḥ .. 56 ..
4.141.d:
सर्वेषामथवा दद्याद्गुरुर्वा येन तुष्यति ॥
सुमंत्रेण प्रदातव्याः सर्वाः सर्वार्थदक्षिणाः ॥ 56 ॥
4.141.m: Or he may give to all whatever pleases the preceptor; / all priestly gifts for every purpose should be given with appropriate mantras:

4.141.s:
kapile sarvadevānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇī ..
tīrthadevamayī yasmādataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 57 ..
4.141.d:
कपिले सर्वदेवानां पूजनीयासि रोहिणी ॥
तीर्थदेवमयी यस्मादतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 57 ॥
4.141.m: 'O tawny cow, you are worthy of worship by all the gods, O Rohiṇī! / Since you are made of all sacred fords and deities, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
puṇyastvaṃ śaṃkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ..
viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 58 ..
4.141.d:
पुण्यस्त्वं शंख पुण्यानां मङ्गलानां च मंगलम् ॥
विष्णुना विधृतो नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 58 ॥
4.141.m: 'O conch, you are holy among holy things and the auspiciousness of all auspicious things; / you are eternally held by Viṣṇu, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
dharma tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ ..
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 59 ..
4.141.d:
धर्म त्वं वृषरूपेण जगदानन्दकारकः ॥
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्ठानमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 59 ॥
4.141.m: 'O Dharma, in the form of a bull you bring joy to the world; / you are the mount of the Eight-formed Lord [Śiva], therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hema bījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ ..
anantapuṇyaphaladamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 4.141.60 ..
4.141.d:
हिरण्यगर्भगर्भस्थं हेम बीजं विभावसोः ॥
अनन्तपुण्यफलदमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 4.141.60 ॥
4.141.m: 'Gold, resting within the womb of Hiraṇyagarbha, is the seed of Fire; / it grants the fruit of endless merit, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
pītavastrayugaṃ dadyādvāsudevasya vallabham ..
pradānāttasya me viṣṇurataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayacchatu .. 61 ..
4.141.d:
पीतवस्त्रयुगं दद्याद्वासुदेवस्य वल्लभम् ॥
प्रदानात्तस्य मे विष्णुरतः शांतिं प्रयच्छतु ॥ 61 ॥
4.141.m: 'One should present a pair of yellow garments, dear to Vāsudeva; / from that gift, may Viṣṇu therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
kapilastvaśvarūpeṇa yasmādamṛtasambhavaḥ ..
candrārkavāhano nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 62 ..
4.141.d:
कपिलस्त्वश्वरूपेण यस्मादमृतसम्भवः ॥
चन्द्रार्कवाहनो नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 62 ॥
4.141.m: 'O tawny horse, since in the form of a steed you were born from the nectar, / and are ever the mount of the Moon and the Sun, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
yasmāttvaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dheno vai kṛṣṇasaṃjñitā ..
sarvapāpaharā nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 63 ..
4.141.d:
यस्मात्त्वं पृथिवी सर्वा धेनो वै कृष्णसंज्ञिता ॥
सर्वपापहरा नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 63 ॥
4.141.m: 'O cow designated as black, since you are the entire earth / and ever the remover of all sins, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
yasmādāyasa karmāṇi tavādhīnāni sarvadā ..
lāṃgalānyāyudhādīni tasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 64 ..
4.141.d:
यस्मादायस कर्माणि तवाधीनानि सर्वदा ॥
लांगलान्यायुधादीनि तस्माच्छांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 64 ॥
4.141.m: 'Since iron implements such as plows and weapons / are forever subject to you, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
yasmāttvaṃ chāga yajñānāmaṃgatvena vyavasthitaḥ ..
yonirvibhāvasornityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me .. 65 ..
4.141.d:
यस्मात्त्वं छाग यज्ञानामंगत्वेन व्यवस्थितः ॥
योनिर्विभावसोर्नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥ 65 ॥
4.141.m: 'O he-goat, since you stand as an essential limb of sacrifices / and are ever the source of Fire, therefore grant me peace.'

4.141.s:
gavāmaṃgeṣu tiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa ..
yasmāttasmācchivaṃ me syādiha loke paratra ca .. .. 66 ..
4.141.d:
गवामंगेषु तिष्ठंति भुवनानि चतुर्दश ॥
यस्मात्तस्माच्छिवं मे स्यादिह लोके परत्र च ॥ ॥ 66 ॥
4.141.m: 'The fourteen worlds abide within the limbs of cows; / because of that, may there be auspiciousness for me in this world and in the next.'

4.141.s:
yasmādaśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca ..
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani .. 67 ..
4.141.d:
यस्मादशून्यं शयनं केशवस्य शिवस्य च ॥
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनि जन्मनि ॥ 67 ॥
4.141.m: 'Just as the couch of Keśava and of Śiva is never empty, / so too may my bed never be empty, birth after birth.'

4.141.s:
yathā ratneṣu sarveṣu sarve devā vyavasthitāḥ ..
tathā śāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃtu ratnadānena me surāḥ .. 68 ..
4.141.d:
यथा रत्नेषु सर्वेषु सर्वे देवा व्यवस्थिताः ॥
तथा शांतिं प्रयच्छंतु रत्नदानेन मे सुराः ॥ 68 ॥
4.141.m: 'Just as all the gods abide in all precious stones, / so may the gods grant me peace through the gift of gems.'

4.141.s:
yathā bhūmipradānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ..
dānānyanyāni me śāṃtiṃ bhūmi dānādbhavatyapi .. 69 ..
4.141.d:
यथा भूमिप्रदानस्य कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् ॥
दानान्यन्यानि मे शांतिं भूमि दानाद्भवत्यपि ॥ 69 ॥
4.141.m: 'Just as other gifts do not equal even a sixteenth part of a gift of land, / may peace come to me from the gift of land.'

4.141.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjayedbhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ..
vastrakāñcanaratnaughairmālyagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ .. 4.141.70 ..
4.141.d:
एवं संपूजयेद्भक्त्या वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जितः ॥
वस्त्रकाञ्चनरत्नौघैर्माल्यगंधानुलेपनैः ॥ 4.141.70 ॥
4.141.m: Thus he should worship with devotion, free from deceit regarding his wealth, / with heaps of garments, gold, and jewels, and with garlands, perfumes, and unguents.

4.141.s:
grahasvarūpamatulaṃ kathyamānaṃ nibodha me ..
bhaktibhāvaprapannasya kathyamānaṃ virājate ..
padmāsanaḥ padmakaraḥ padmagarbhasamadyutiḥ ..
saptāśvaḥ saptarajjuśca dvibhujaḥ syātsadā raviḥ .. .. 71 ..
4.141.d:
ग्रहस्वरूपमतुलं कथ्यमानं निबोध मे ॥
भक्तिभावप्रपन्नस्य कथ्यमानं विराजते ॥
पद्मासनः पद्मकरः पद्मगर्भसमद्युतिः ॥
सप्ताश्वः सप्तरज्जुश्च द्विभुजः स्यात्सदा रविः ॥ ॥ 71 ॥
4.141.m: Hear from me the incomparable forms of the planets as they are described; / described to one endowed with devotion, they shine forth: / The Sun should always be seated on a lotus, holding a lotus in his hand, radiant like the interior of a lotus, / possessing seven horses, seven reins, and two arms.

4.141.s:
śvetaḥ śvetāṃbaradharo daśāśvaḥ śvetabhūṣaṇaḥ ..
gadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśī .. 72 ..
4.141.d:
श्वेतः श्वेतांबरधरो दशाश्वः श्वेतभूषणः ॥
गदापाणिर्द्विबाहुश्च कर्तव्यो वरदः शशी ॥ 72 ॥
4.141.m: White, wearing white garments, with ten horses and white ornaments, / holding a mace in hand, two-armed, and bestowing boons: such should the Moon be made.

4.141.s:
raktamālyāṃbaradharaḥ karṇikārasamaṃdyutiḥ ..
khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇirvidheyo bhūminaṃdanaḥ .. 73 ..
4.141.d:
रक्तमाल्यांबरधरः कर्णिकारसमंद्युतिः ॥
खड्गचर्मगदापाणिर्विधेयो भूमिनंदनः ॥ 73 ॥
4.141.m: Wearing red garlands and garments, with a splendour like the karṇikāra flower, / holding a sword, shield, and mace in hand, the Son of the Earth [Mars] should be made.

4.141.s:
pītamālyāṃbaradharaḥ pītagaṃdhānulepanaḥ ..
kāṃcane ca rathe divye śobhamāno budhaḥ sadā .. 74 ..
4.141.d:
पीतमाल्यांबरधरः पीतगंधानुलेपनः ॥
कांचने च रथे दिव्ये शोभमानो बुधः सदा ॥ 74 ॥
4.141.m: Wearing yellow garlands and garments, anointed with yellow fragrant unguents, / Mercury should ever be resplendent in a divine golden chariot.

4.141.s:
devadaityagurū tadvatpītaśvetau caturbhujau ..
daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaḍalū .. 75 ..
4.141.d:
देवदैत्यगुरू तद्वत्पीतश्वेतौ चतुर्भुजौ ॥
दंडिनौ वरदौ कार्यौ साक्षसूत्रकमडलू ॥ 75 ॥
4.141.m: Likewise, the preceptors of the gods and of the Daityas [Jupiter and Venus], yellow and white respectively, four-armed, / carrying staffs, bestowing boons, and holding rosaries and water pots, should be made.

4.141.s:
indranīladyutiḥ śūlī varado gṛdhravāhanaḥ ..
bāṇabāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyo'rkasutaḥ sadā .. 76 ..
4.141.d:
इन्द्रनीलद्युतिः शूली वरदो गृध्रवाहनः ॥
बाणबाणासनधरः कर्तव्योऽर्कसुतः सदा ॥ 76 ॥
4.141.m: Radiant like a sapphire, holding a trident, bestowing boons, mounted on a vulture, / holding arrows and a bow: such should the son of Arka [Saturn] always be made.

4.141.s:
śārdūlavadanaḥ khaḍgī varmī śūlī varapradaḥ ..
nīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhuratra praśasyate .. 77 ..
4.141.d:
शार्दूलवदनः खड्गी वर्मी शूली वरप्रदः ॥
नीलसिंहासनस्थश्च राहुरत्र प्रशस्यते ॥ 77 ॥
4.141.m: With the face of a tiger, holding a sword, armoured, bearing a trident, granting boons, / and seated upon a blue throne: Rāhu is praised here as such.

4.141.s:
dhūmrā dvibāhavaḥ sarve gadino vikṛtānanāḥ ..
gṛdhrāsanaratā nityaṃ ketavaḥ syurvarapradāḥ .. 78 ..
4.141.d:
धूम्रा द्विबाहवः सर्वे गदिनो विकृताननाः ॥
गृध्रासनरता नित्यं केतवः स्युर्वरप्रदाः ॥ 78 ॥
4.141.m: Smoke-coloured, all two-armed, holding maces, with deformed faces, / ever seated upon vultures, the Ketus should be granters of boons.

4.141.s:
sarve kirīṭinaḥ kāryā grahā lokahitāvahāḥ ..
svāṃgulenocchritāḥ sarve śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tadā .. 79 ..
4.141.d:
सर्वे किरीटिनः कार्या ग्रहा लोकहितावहाः ॥
स्वांगुलेनोच्छ्रिताः सर्वे शतमष्टोत्तरं तदा ॥ 79 ॥
4.141.m: All the planets, bringers of welfare to the world, should be made wearing diadems; / each should be one hundred and eight finger-breadths in height according to their own measure.

4.141.s:
grahasvarūpametatte vyākhyātaṃ pāṃḍunandana ..
etajjñātvā prayatnena pūjā kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 4.141.80 ..
4.141.d:
ग्रहस्वरूपमेतत्ते व्याख्यातं पांडुनन्दन ॥
एतज्ज्ञात्वा प्रयत्नेन पूजा कार्या विचक्षणैः ॥ 4.141.80 ॥
4.141.m: This form of the planets has been expounded to you, O son of Pāṇḍu; / having understood this, worship should be performed diligently by the discerning.

4.141.s:
vidhinā grahapūjāṃ yonena tvārabhate naraḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate .. 81 ..
4.141.d:
विधिना ग्रहपूजां योनेन त्वारभते नरः ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति प्रेत्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 81 ॥
4.141.m: The man who undertakes worship of the planets according to rule with this [method] / attains all desires, and after death is glorified in heaven.

4.141.s:
yastu pīḍākaro nityaṃ mālyavittasya vā grahaḥ ..
taṃ tu yatnena saṃpūjya śeṣānapyarcayedbudhaḥ .. 82 ..
4.141.d:
यस्तु पीडाकरो नित्यं माल्यवित्तस्य वा ग्रहः ॥
तं तु यत्नेन संपूज्य शेषानप्यर्चयेद्बुधः ॥ 82 ॥
4.141.m: Whichever planet constantly causes affliction to wealth or garlands, / the wise man should worship that one with effort, and worship the remaining ones as well.

4.141.s:
grahā gāvo narendrāśca brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
pūjitāḥ pūjayaṃtyete nirdahaṃtyavamānitāḥ .. 83 ..
4.141.d:
ग्रहा गावो नरेन्द्राश्च ब्राह्मणाश्च विशेषतः ॥
पूजिताः पूजयंत्येते निर्दहंत्यवमानिताः ॥ 83 ॥
4.141.m: Planets, cows, kings, and especially brāhmaṇas— / when worshipped, these [all] honour [him]; when disrespected, they burn [him] down.

4.141.s:
tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
saṃpūrṇāyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ yasmādeko'pi tuṣyati .. 84 ..
4.141.d:
तस्मान्न दक्षिणाहीनं कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥
संपूर्णायां दक्षिणायां यस्मादेकोऽपि तुष्यति ॥ 84 ॥
4.141.m: Therefore one who desires prosperity should not perform it devoid of a sacrificial fee, / because when the fee is complete, even a single one is satisfied.

4.141.s: sadaivā'yutahomo'yaṃ navagrahamakhaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 85 ..
4.141.d: सदैवाऽयुतहोमोऽयं नवग्रहमखः स्मृतः ॥ 85 ॥
4.141.m: This sacrifice to the nine planets is always remembered as a sacrifice of ten thousand oblations.

4.141.s:
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu ..
nirvighnārthaṃ mahārāja tathodvegādbhuteṣu ca .. 86 ..
4.141.d:
विवाहोत्सवयज्ञेषु प्रतिष्ठादिषु कर्मसु ॥
निर्विघ्नार्थं महाराज तथोद्वेगाद्भुतेषु च ॥ 86 ॥
4.141.m: In marriages, festivals, and sacrifices, in consecration and other rites, / for the removal of obstacles, O great king, and likewise in times of anxiety and portents,

4.141.s:
kathito'yutahomo'yaṃ lakṣahomamataḥ śṛṇu ..
sarvakāmāptaye yasmāllakṣa homaṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 87 ..
4.141.d:
कथितोऽयुतहोमोऽयं लक्षहोममतः शृणु ॥
सर्वकामाप्तये यस्माल्लक्ष होमं विदुर्बुधाः ॥ 87 ॥
4.141.m: this sacrifice of ten thousand oblations has been declared. Now listen to the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations; / for the wise know the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations to bring attainment of all desires,

4.141.s:
pitṝṇāṃ vallabho yasmādbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ ..
grahatārābalaṃ labdhvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam .. 88 ..
4.141.d:
पितॄणां वल्लभो यस्माद्भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदः ॥
ग्रहताराबलं लब्ध्वा कृत्वा ब्राह्मणवाचनम् ॥ 88 ॥
4.141.m: because it is dear to the ancestors and bestows the fruit of enjoyment and liberation. / Having obtained the strength of the planets and asterisms and having the brāhmaṇas recite blessings,

4.141.s:
gṛhasyottarapūrveṇa maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ..
rudrāyatanabhūmau vā caturasramudaṅmukham .. 89 ..
4.141.d:
गृहस्योत्तरपूर्वेण मण्डपं कारयेद्बुधः ॥
रुद्रायतनभूमौ वा चतुरस्रमुदङ्मुखम् ॥ 89 ॥
4.141.m: the wise man should have a pavilion built to the northeast of the house / or on the ground of a sanctuary of Rudra, four-sided and facing north.

4.141.s:
daśahastamathāṣṭau vā hastānkuryādvidhānataḥ ..
prāgudakpravaṇāṃ bhūmiṃ kārayedyatnato naraḥ .. 4.141.90 ..
4.141.d:
दशहस्तमथाष्टौ वा हस्तान्कुर्याद्विधानतः ॥
प्रागुदक्प्रवणां भूमिं कारयेद्यत्नतो नरः ॥ 4.141.90 ॥
4.141.m: He should make it ten cubits or eight cubits according to rule; / a man should carefully have the ground made sloping toward the northeast.

4.141.s:
prāguttaraṃ samāsādya pradeśaṃ maṃḍapasya tu ..
śobhanaṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ yathāvallakṣaṇānvitam .. 91 ..
4.141.d:
प्रागुत्तरं समासाद्य प्रदेशं मंडपस्य तु ॥
शोभनं कारयेत्कुण्डं यथावल्लक्षणान्वितम् ॥ 91 ॥
4.141.m: Reaching the northeastern region of the pavilion, / he should have a beautiful sacrificial pit made, properly furnished with the required characteristics.

4.141.s:
mānahīnaṃ cāpraśastamanekabhayadaṃ bhavet ..
yasmāttasmātsusaṃpūrṇaṃ śāṃtikuṃḍaṃ vidhīyate .. 92 ..
4.141.d:
मानहीनं चाप्रशस्तमनेकभयदं भवेत् ॥
यस्मात्तस्मात्सुसंपूर्णं शांतिकुंडं विधीयते ॥ 92 ॥
4.141.m: Lacking proper measurement and unpraiseworthy, it would cause many fears; / therefore, a sacrificial pit for pacification is prescribed as perfectly complete.

4.141.s:
asmāddaśaguṇaḥ prokto lakṣahome svayaṃbhuvā ..
āhutibhiḥ prayatnena dakṣiṇābhistathaiva ca .. 93 ..
4.141.d:
अस्माद्दशगुणः प्रोक्तो लक्षहोमे स्वयंभुवा ॥
आहुतिभिः प्रयत्नेन दक्षिणाभिस्तथैव च ॥ 93 ॥
4.141.m: In the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations, it is declared by the Self-born to be tenfold compared to this, / in its oblations with care, and likewise in its sacrificial fees.

4.141.s:
dvihastavistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhastāyataṃ punaḥ ..
lakṣahome bhavetkuṇḍaṃ yonivaktraṃ trimekhalam .. 94 ..
4.141.d:
द्विहस्तविस्तृतं तद्वच्चतुर्हस्तायतं पुनः ॥
लक्षहोमे भवेत्कुण्डं योनिवक्त्रं त्रिमेखलम् ॥ 94 ॥
4.141.m: In the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations, the sacrificial pit should likewise be two cubits wide / and four cubits long, with a yoni-shaped opening and three girdles,

4.141.s:
saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ vapratrayasamāvṛtam ..
dviraṃgulocchrito vapraḥ prathamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ .. 95 ..
4.141.d:
संस्थापनाय देवानां वप्रत्रयसमावृतम् ॥
द्विरंगुलोच्छ्रितो वप्रः प्रथमः समुदाहृतः ॥ 95 ॥
4.141.m: surrounded by three tiers for the establishment of the deities. / The first tier is stated to be two finger-breadths high;

4.141.s:
aṃgulocchrayasaṃyuktaṃ vapradvayamathopari ..
dvyaṅgulastatra vistāraḥ sarveṣāṃ kathyate budhaiḥ .. 96 ..
4.141.d:
अंगुलोच्छ्रयसंयुक्तं वप्रद्वयमथोपरि ॥
द्व्यङ्गुलस्तत्र विस्तारः सर्वेषां कथ्यते बुधैः ॥ 96 ॥
4.141.m: then above it are two tiers, each one finger-breadth high. / The width of all of them there is said by the wise to be two finger-breadths.

4.141.s:
daśāṃgulocchritā bhittiḥ sthaṃḍilasya tathopari ..
tasminnāvāhayeddevānpūrvavatpuṣpataṇḍulaiḥ .. 97 ..
4.141.d:
दशांगुलोच्छ्रिता भित्तिः स्थंडिलस्य तथोपरि ॥
तस्मिन्नावाहयेद्देवान्पूर्ववत्पुष्पतण्डुलैः ॥ 97 ॥
4.141.m: The wall of the raised altar above it is ten finger-breadths high. / Upon it he should invoke the deities with flowers and raw rice grains as before.

4.141.s:
ādityābhimukhāḥ sarvāḥ sthāpyāḥ pratyadhidevatāḥ ..
sthāpanīyā muniśreṣṭhā nāṃtareṇa parāṅmukhāḥ .. 98 ..
4.141.d:
आदित्याभिमुखाः सर्वाः स्थाप्याः प्रत्यधिदेवताः ॥
स्थापनीया मुनिश्रेष्ठा नांतरेण पराङ्मुखाः ॥ 98 ॥
4.141.m: All the secondary and primary presiding deities must be established facing Āditya; / they should be set up, O best of sages, without facing away [from him].

4.141.s:
garutmānadhikastatra saṃpūjyaḥ śriyamicchatā ..
samapīnaśarīrastu vāhanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ..99..
4.141.d:
गरुत्मानधिकस्तत्र संपूज्यः श्रियमिच्छता ॥
समपीनशरीरस्तु वाहनं परमेष्ठिनः ॥99॥
4.141.m: Garutmān should be worshipped there additionally by one who desires fortune; / he has an evenly plump body and is the mount of Parameṣṭhin.

4.141.s:
viṣapāpaharo nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me ..
pūrvavatkuṃbhamāmaṃtrya tadvaddhomaṃ samācaret ..4.141.1 00..
4.141.d:
विषपापहरो नित्यमतः शांतिं प्रयच्छ मे ॥
पूर्ववत्कुंभमामंत्र्य तद्वद्धोमं समाचरेत् ॥4.141.1 00॥
4.141.m: He constantly removes poison and sin: “Therefore bestow peace upon me.” / Having consecrated the water pot as before, he should perform the oblation in that manner.

4.141.s:
sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ hutvā samitsaṃkhyādikaṃ punaḥ ..
audumbarīmathārdrāṃ ca vakrakoṭaravarjitām .. 101 ..
4.141.d:
सहस्राणां शतं हुत्वा समित्संख्यादिकं पुनः ॥
औदुम्बरीमथार्द्रां च वक्रकोटरवर्जिताम् ॥ 101 ॥
4.141.m: Having offered a hundred thousand [oblations] with the count of firewood sticks and the rest, / then [making] an unctuous udumbara [ladle] free from crookedness and hollows,

4.141.s:
bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ staṃbhadvayopari ..
ghṛtadhārāṃ tathā samyagagnerupari pātayet ..1 02..
4.141.d:
बाहुमात्रां स्रुचं कृत्वा ततः स्तंभद्वयोपरि ॥
घृतधारां तथा सम्यगग्नेरुपरि पातयेत् ॥1 02॥
4.141.m: having fashioned a sruc ladle one arm-length [long], then resting on two posts / he should properly pour a stream of clarified butter upon the fire.

4.141.s:
pāṭhayetsūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramaiṃdavam ..
mahāvaiśvānaraṃ sāma jyeṣṭhasāma ca pāṭhayet ..103..
4.141.d:
पाठयेत्सूक्तमाग्नेयं वैष्णवं रौद्रमैंदवम् ॥
महावैश्वानरं साम ज्येष्ठसाम च पाठयेत् ॥103॥
4.141.m: He should have the hymn to Agni recited, the one to Viṣṇu, the one to Rudra, and the one to Soma; / he should also have the Mahāvaiśvānara Sāman and the Jyeṣṭha Sāman recited.

4.141.s:
snānaṃ tu yajamānasya pūrvavanmantravācanam ..
dātavyā yajamānena pūrvavaddakṣiṇā pṛthak .. 104 ..
4.141.d:
स्नानं तु यजमानस्य पूर्ववन्मन्त्रवाचनम् ॥
दातव्या यजमानेन पूर्ववद्दक्षिणा पृथक् ॥ 104 ॥
4.141.m: The bathing of the patron is as before, and the recitation of mantras. / The sacrificial fee must be given separately by the patron as before,

4.141.s:
kāmakrodhavihīnena ṛtvigbhyaḥ śāṃtacetasaḥ ..
navagraha makhe viprāścatvāro vedavedinaḥ .. 105 ..
4.141.d:
कामक्रोधविहीनेन ऋत्विग्भ्यः शांतचेतसः ॥
नवग्रह मखे विप्राश्चत्वारो वेदवेदिनः ॥ 105 ॥
4.141.m: free from desire and anger, with a calm mind, to the officiating priests. / In the sacrifice to the nine planets, there should be four brāhmaṇas who know the Veda.

4.141.s:
atha vā ṛtvijau śāṃtau dvāveva tvatikovidau ..
kāryāvayutahome tu na prasajyeta vistare .. 106 ..
4.141.d:
अथ वा ऋत्विजौ शांतौ द्वावेव त्वतिकोविदौ ॥
कार्यावयुतहोमे तु न प्रसज्येत विस्तरे ॥ 106 ॥
4.141.m: Or, in the sacrifice of ten thousand oblations, just two calm and very skilled officiating priests / should be employed; he should not indulge in excessive elaboration.

4.141.s:
tadvacca daśa cāṣṭau vā lakṣahome'pi ṛtvijaḥ..
kartavyāḥ śaktitastadvaccatvāro vā vimatsarāḥ ..1 07..
4.141.d:
तद्वच्च दश चाष्टौ वा लक्षहोमेऽपि ऋत्विजः॥
कर्तव्याः शक्तितस्तद्वच्चत्वारो वा विमत्सराः ॥1 07॥
4.141.m: Likewise, in the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations, ten or eight officiating priests / should be appointed according to capacity, or four free from envy.

4.141.s:
navagrahamakhe sarvaṃ lakṣahome daśottaram..
dadyācca pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha bhūṣaṇānyapi śaktitaḥ .. 108 ..
4.141.d:
नवग्रहमखे सर्वं लक्षहोमे दशोत्तरम्॥
दद्याच्च पांडवश्रेष्ठ भूषणान्यपि शक्तितः ॥ 108 ॥
4.141.m: Everything in the sacrifice to the nine planets should be tenfold in the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations; / and he should give ornaments according to capacity, O best of the Pāṇḍavas.

4.141.s:
śayanāni ca vastrāṇi haimāni kaṭakāni ca ..
karṇāṃgulīpavitrāṇi bhaktimānpratipādayet ..1 09..
4.141.d:
शयनानि च वस्त्राणि हैमानि कटकानि च ॥
कर्णांगुलीपवित्राणि भक्तिमान्प्रतिपादयेत् ॥1 09॥
4.141.m: Beds, garments, golden bracelets, / and ear and finger rings the devout [patron] should bestow.

4.141.s:
na kuryāddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vittaśāṭhyena mānavaḥ ..
adadallobhamohābhyāṃ kulakṣayamavāpnuyāt .. 4.141.110 ..
4.141.d:
न कुर्याद्दक्षिणाहीनं वित्तशाठ्येन मानवः ॥
अददल्लोभमोहाभ्यां कुलक्षयमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 4.141.110 ॥
4.141.m: A man should not perform it devoid of a sacrificial fee out of stinginess with his wealth; / by not giving out of greed and delusion, he would incur the destruction of his family.

4.141.s:
annadānaṃ yathā śaktyā dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ..
annahīnaṃ vrataṃ yasmāddurbhikṣaphaladaṃ bhavet .. 111 ..
4.141.d:
अन्नदानं यथा शक्त्या दातव्यं भूतिमिच्छता ॥
अन्नहीनं व्रतं यस्माद्दुर्भिक्षफलदं भवेत् ॥ 111 ॥
4.141.m: The gift of food must be given according to capacity by one who desires prosperity, / because a votive observance devoid of food would yield the fruit of famine.

4.141.s:
rāṣṭraṃ hanyādaṃgahīno maṃtrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ ..
adakṣiṇo yajamānaṃ nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ .. 112 ..
4.141.d:
राष्ट्रं हन्यादंगहीनो मंत्रहीनस्तु ऋत्विजः ॥
अदक्षिणो यजमानं नास्ति यज्ञसमो रिपुः ॥ 112 ॥
4.141.m: A rite lacking limbs destroys the realm; one lacking mantras destroys the officiating priests; / one lacking a sacrificial fee destroys the patron: there is no enemy equal to [such] a sacrifice.

4.141.s:
na cāpyalpadhanaḥ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ naraḥ kvacit ..
tasmātpīḍākaro nityaṃ ya eva bhavati grahaḥ .. 113 ..
4.141.d:
न चाप्यल्पधनः कुर्याल्लक्षहोमं नरः क्वचित् ॥
तस्मात्पीडाकरो नित्यं य एव भवति ग्रहः ॥ 113 ॥
4.141.m: Nor should a man of little wealth ever perform the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations. / Therefore, whichever planet is constantly causing affliction,

4.141.s:
tameva pūjayedbhaktyā dvau vā trīnvā yathāvidhi ..
ekamapyarcayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ veda pāragam ..114 ..
4.141.d:
तमेव पूजयेद्भक्त्या द्वौ वा त्रीन्वा यथाविधि ॥
एकमप्यर्चयेद्भक्त्या ब्राह्मणं वेद पारगम् ॥114 ॥
4.141.m: that very one he should worship with devotion, or two, or three, according to rule. / With devotion he should worship even a single brāhmaṇa who has mastered the Veda,

4.141.s:
dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena bahūnvā bahuvittavān ..
lakṣahomastu kartavyo yadi vittaṃ gṛhe gṛhe .. 115 ..
4.141.d:
दक्षिणाभिः प्रयत्नेन बहून्वा बहुवित्तवान् ॥
लक्षहोमस्तु कर्तव्यो यदि वित्तं गृहे गृहे ॥ 115 ॥
4.141.m: with sacrificial fees, with care; or many, if he possesses much wealth. / The sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations should be performed if there is wealth in every house,

4.141.s:
yataḥ sarvānavāpnoti kurvankāmānvidhānataḥ ..
pūjyate śivaloke ca vasvādityamarudgaṇaiḥ .. 116 ..
4.141.d:
यतः सर्वानवाप्नोति कुर्वन्कामान्विधानतः ॥
पूज्यते शिवलोके च वस्वादित्यमरुद्गणैः ॥ 116 ॥
4.141.m: since by performing it according to rule he attains all desires, / and he is worshipped in the world of Śiva by the Vasus, Ādityas, and the hosts of Maruts,

4.141.s:
yāvatkalpaśatānyaṣṭāvatha mokṣamavāpnuyāt..
sakāmo yastvimaṃ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ yathāvidhi ..117..
4.141.d:
यावत्कल्पशतान्यष्टावथ मोक्षमवाप्नुयात्॥
सकामो यस्त्विमं कुर्याल्लक्षहोमं यथाविधि ॥117॥
4.141.m: for as long as eight hundred eons; and then he obtains liberation. / But whoever performs this sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations according to rule with a specific desire,

4.141.s:
sa taṃ kāmamavāpnoti padaṃ cānaṃtyamaśnute..
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..118..
4.141.d:
स तं काममवाप्नोति पदं चानंत्यमश्नुते॥
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ॥118॥
4.141.m: he attains that desire and enjoys an endless station. / One who desires a son obtains a son; one who desires wealth obtains wealth.

4.141.s:
bhāryārthī śobhanāṃ bhāryāṃ kumārī ca śubhaṃ patim ..
bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt .. 119 ..
4.141.d:
भार्यार्थी शोभनां भार्यां कुमारी च शुभं पतिम् ॥
भ्रष्टराज्यस्तथा राज्यं श्रीकामः श्रियमाप्नुयात् ॥ 119 ॥
4.141.m: One who desires a wife [obtains] a beautiful wife, and an unmarried girl obtains a good husband; / likewise, one fallen from his kingdom obtains a kingdom, and one who desires fortune obtains fortune.

4.141.s:
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ tamāpnoti puṣkalam ..
niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃ brahma sa gacchati .. 4.141.120 ..
4.141.d:
यं यं प्रार्थयते कामं तं तमाप्नोति पुष्कलम् ॥
निष्कामः कुरुते यस्तु परं ब्रह्म स गच्छति ॥ 4.141.120 ॥
4.141.m: Whatever desire he asks for, that he abundantly obtains; / but he who performs it without desire goes to the supreme Brahman.

4.141.s:
śāṃtiṃ navagrahamayīṃ duritopaśāṃtiṃ rājankaroti bahunā vidhivaddvijendraiḥ ..
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamatulaṃ kulavṛddhisaṃpattatrāsti yatra kurute bata lakṣahomam ..121..
koṭihomavidhivarṇanam
4.141.d:
शांतिं नवग्रहमयीं दुरितोपशांतिं राजन्करोति बहुना विधिवद्द्विजेन्द्रैः ॥
क्षेमं सुभिक्षमतुलं कुलवृद्धिसंपत्तत्रास्ति यत्र कुरुते बत लक्षहोमम् ॥121॥
कोटिहोमविधिवर्णनम्
4.141.m:
O king, when one performs the pacification consisting of the nine planets that allays misfortunes, through many foremost twice-born according to rule, / there is safety, matchless abundance of food, family growth, and prosperity, wherever one performs, indeed, the sacrifice of one hundred thousand oblations.
Description of the Rule for the Sacrifice of Ten Million Oblations

4.142.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rājā saṃvaraṇaḥ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāne purottame ..
babhūva sa mahābhāgaḥ śāstrārthakuśalo balī ..1..
4.142.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
राजा संवरणः पूर्वं प्रतिष्ठाने पुरोत्तमे ॥
बभूव स महाभागः शास्त्रार्थकुशलो बली ॥1॥
4.142.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly there was King Saṃvaraṇa in the excellent city of Pratiṣṭhāna; / he was highly fortunate, skilled in the meaning of the treatises, and mighty.

4.142.s:
brahmaṇyaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ ..
tasyātha kurvato rājyaṃ samyakpālayataḥ prajāḥ ..2..
4.142.d:
ब्रह्मण्यः पितृभक्तश्च देवब्राह्मणपूजकः ॥
तस्याथ कुर्वतो राज्यं सम्यक्पालयतः प्रजाः ॥2॥
4.142.m: pious toward Brahmins, devoted to the ancestors, and a worshipper of the gods and Brahmins. / As he was thus ruling his realm and properly protecting his subjects,

4.142.s:
ājagāma mahāyogī sanako brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ..
dattvā tasyāsanaṃ rājā praṇamya śirasā tathā ..3..
4.142.d:
आजगाम महायोगी सनको ब्रह्मणः सुतः॥
दत्त्वा तस्यासनं राजा प्रणम्य शिरसा तथा ॥3॥
4.142.m: the great yogin Sanaka, the son of Brahmā, arrived. / The king offered him a seat, bowed with his head,

4.142.s:
pūjayitvārghyapādyādyairātmānaṃ vinivedya ca ..
itihāsapurāṇoktāścakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ ..4..
4.142.d:
पूजयित्वार्घ्यपाद्याद्यैरात्मानं विनिवेद्य च ॥
इतिहासपुराणोक्ताश्चकार विविधाः कथाः ॥4॥
4.142.m: and worshipped him with arghya, water for washing the feet, and other offerings, placing himself at his disposal. / He related various tales told in the epics and Purāṇas,

4.142.s:
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇāṃ ca caritāni yathārthavit ..
tataḥ kathāṃtare rājā kāryaṃ manasi saṃsthitam ..5..
4.142.d:
राजर्षीणां पुराणां च चरितानि यथार्थवित् ॥
ततः कथांतरे राजा कार्यं मनसि संस्थितम् ॥5॥
4.142.m: and the deeds of ancient royal sages, being one who knew their true meaning. / Then, in the midst of conversation, the king, [keeping] in mind a matter that preoccupied him,

4.142.s:
hitāya pṛthivīśānāṃ jagataścātmanastathā ..
papraccha vinayopeto yogācāryaṃ mahāmatiḥ .. 6 ..
4.142.d:
हिताय पृथिवीशानां जगतश्चात्मनस्तथा ॥
पप्रच्छ विनयोपेतो योगाचार्यं महामतिः ॥ 6 ॥
4.142.m: for the benefit of the lords of the earth, of the world, and of himself, / asked the master of yoga with humility, being of great intellect:

4.142.s:
.. saṃvaraṇa uvāca .. ..
bhagavanmahadutpātasaṃbhave bhūprakaṃpane ..
nirghāte pāṃśuvarṣe ca gṛhabhaṃge tathaiva ca .. 7 ..
4.142.d:
॥ संवरण उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्महदुत्पातसंभवे भूप्रकंपने ॥
निर्घाते पांशुवर्षे च गृहभंगे तथैव च ॥ 7 ॥
4.142.m: Saṃvaraṇa said: / "O venerable one, when great portents occur, when the earth trembles, / when there is a thunderstroke, a shower of dust, or the destruction of homes,

4.142.s:
janmanakṣatrapīḍāsu anāvṛṣṭibhayeṣu ca ..
jvareṣu grahapīḍāsu durbhikṣe rāṣṭravigrahe .. .. 8 ..
4.142.d:
जन्मनक्षत्रपीडासु अनावृष्टिभयेषु च ॥
ज्वरेषु ग्रहपीडासु दुर्भिक्षे राष्ट्रविग्रहे ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
4.142.m: during afflictions caused by one's birth-star, when there is fear of drought, / during fevers, afflictions caused by the planets, famine, or warfare in the realm,

4.142.s:
vyādhīnāṃ saṃbhave jāte śarīre cātipīḍite ..
kleśe mahati cotpanne kiṃ kartavyaṃ narottamaiḥ .. 9 ..
4.142.d:
व्याधीनां संभवे जाते शरीरे चातिपीडिते ॥
क्लेशे महति चोत्पन्ने किं कर्तव्यं नरोत्तमैः ॥ 9 ॥
4.142.m: when diseases break out, when the body is afflicted by severe pain, / and when great misery has arisen, what should be done by the best of men?

4.142.s:
svargasya sādhanaṃ yacca kīrtidaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā ..
prabrūhi me dvijaśreṣṭha tathārogyapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 4.142.10 ..
4.142.d:
स्वर्गस्य साधनं यच्च कीर्तिदं धनदं तथा ॥
प्रब्रूहि मे द्विजश्रेष्ठ तथारोग्यप्रदं नृणाम् ॥ 4.142.10 ॥
4.142.m: Tell me, O best of the twice-born, what brings about heaven, confers fame and wealth, / and likewise grants health to mankind?"

4.142.s:
.. sanatkumāra uvāca .. ..
śṛṇurājanpravakṣyāmi śāṃtikarma hyanuttamam ..
koṭihomākhyamatulaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 11 ..
4.142.d:
॥ सनत्कुमार उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणुराजन्प्रवक्ष्यामि शांतिकर्म ह्यनुत्तमम् ॥
कोटिहोमाख्यमतुलं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.142.m: Sanatkumāra said: / "Listen, O king! I shall declare the supreme rite of pacification, / known as the Koṭihoma, peerless and granting the fruit of all desires,

4.142.s:
brahmahatyādipāpāni yena naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt ..
utpātā praśamaṃ yāṃti mahatsaṃpadyate sukham .. 12 ..
4.142.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिपापानि येन नश्यंति तत्क्षणात् ॥
उत्पाता प्रशमं यांति महत्संपद्यते सुखम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.142.m: by which sins such as killing a Brahmin are instantly destroyed, / portents are appeased, and great happiness is attained.

4.142.s:
vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhava ..
devāgāre nadītīre vane vā bhavane'pi vā .. 13 ..
4.142.d:
विधानं तस्य वक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना भव ॥
देवागारे नदीतीरे वने वा भवनेऽपि वा ॥ 13 ॥
4.142.m: I shall declare its procedure: listen and be single-minded! / In a temple, on a riverbank, in a forest, or even in a dwelling,

4.142.s:
parvate vāpi kurvīta ya icchetkṣemamātmanaḥ ..
śubhanakṣatrayoge ca vāre pūrvaguṇānvite .. 14 ..
4.142.d:
पर्वते वापि कुर्वीत य इच्छेत्क्षेममात्मनः ॥
शुभनक्षत्रयोगे च वारे पूर्वगुणान्विते ॥ 14 ॥
4.142.m: or on a mountain, one who desires one's own well-being should perform it / at an auspicious conjunction of constellations and on a day endowed with the aforesaid qualities,

4.142.s:
yajamānasyānukūlye koṭihomaṃ samācaret ..
pūjayitvā prayatnena brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam .. 15 ..
4.142.d:
यजमानस्यानुकूल्ये कोटिहोमं समाचरेत् ॥
पूजयित्वा प्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.142.m: when favourable to the sacrificer, he should perform the Koṭihoma. / Having honoured with diligence a Brahmin who has crossed to the end of the Veda,

4.142.s:
vastrairvibhūṣaṇaiścaiva gaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
praṇamya vidhivattasmai ātmānaṃ vinivedayet .. 16 ..
4.142.d:
वस्त्रैर्विभूषणैश्चैव गंधमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
प्रणम्य विधिवत्तस्मै आत्मानं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.142.m: with garments and ornaments, and with perfumes, garlands, and unguents, / and bowing to him according to rule, he should surrender himself to him, [saying]:

4.142.s:
tvaṃ no gatiḥ pitā mātā tvaṃ gatistvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ ..
tvatprasādena viprarṣe sarvaṃ me syānmanogatam .. 17 ..
4.142.d:
त्वं नो गतिः पिता माता त्वं गतिस्त्वं परायणः ॥
त्वत्प्रसादेन विप्रर्षे सर्वं मे स्यान्मनोगतम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.142.m: 'You are our refuge, father, and mother; you are our recourse, you are our supreme stay. / By your grace, O Brahmin sage, may all the desires of my heart be fulfilled!

4.142.s:
āpadvimokṣāya ca me kuru yajñamanuttamam..
koṭihomārthamatulaṃ śāṃtyarthaṃ sārvakāmikam .. 18 ..
4.142.d:
आपद्विमोक्षाय च मे कुरु यज्ञमनुत्तमम्॥
कोटिहोमार्थमतुलं शांत्यर्थं सार्वकामिकम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.142.m: For my release from adversity, perform this peerless sacrifice, / this incomparable [rite] for the sake of the Koṭihoma, for pacification, fulfilling all desires!'

4.142.s:
purohitastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ ..
brāhmaṇairvedasaṃvṛttaiḥ puṇyairyuktaḥ samāhitaiḥ .. 19 ..
4.142.d:
पुरोहितस्ततः प्राज्ञः शुक्लांबरधरः शुचिः ॥
ब्राह्मणैर्वेदसंवृत्तैः पुण्यैर्युक्तः समाहितैः ॥ 19 ॥
4.142.m: Then the wise family priest, clad in white garments and pure, / accompanied by virtuous, concentrated Brahmins endowed with Vedic learning,

4.142.s:
bhūmibhāge same śuddhe prāgudakpravaṇe tathā ..
puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpūrvaṃ kṛtvā viprānsupūjitān .. 4.142.20 ..
4.142.d:
भूमिभागे समे शुद्धे प्रागुदक्प्रवणे तथा ॥
पुण्याहं वाचयेत्पूर्वं कृत्वा विप्रान्सुपूजितान् ॥ 4.142.20 ॥
4.142.m: on a level, clean piece of ground sloping toward the east or north, / should first have the 'auspicious day' proclaimed, after properly worshipping the Brahmins.

4.142.s:
tatastu mahitairvipraḥ sūtrayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham ..
uttamaṃ śatahastaṃ tu tadardhena tu madhyamam ..
jaghanyaṃ tu tadardhena śaktikālādyapekṣayā ..21..
4.142.d:
ततस्तु महितैर्विप्रः सूत्रयेन्मण्डपं शुभम् ॥
उत्तमं शतहस्तं तु तदर्धेन तु मध्यमम् ॥
जघन्यं तु तदर्धेन शक्तिकालाद्यपेक्षया ॥21॥
4.142.m: Then, together with the honoured Brahmins, he should measure out an auspicious pavilion with cords: / the best is one hundred cubits; half of that is middling; / and half of that is the smallest, according to ability, time, and circumstance.

4.142.s:
madhye tu maṇḍapasyāpi kuṃḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
aṣṭahastapramāṇena āyāmena tathaiva ca .. 22 ..
4.142.d:
मध्ये तु मण्डपस्यापि कुंडं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ॥
अष्टहस्तप्रमाणेन आयामेन तथैव च ॥ 22 ॥
4.142.m: In the middle of the pavilion, the discerning [priest] should make a sacrificial pit, / eight cubits in length and breadth.

4.142.s:
mekhalātritayaṃ tasya dvādaśāṃgulavistatam ..
tatpramāṇāṃ tathā yoniṃ kurvīta susamāhitaḥ .. 23 ..
4.142.d:
मेखलात्रितयं तस्य द्वादशांगुलविस्ततम् ॥
तत्प्रमाणां तथा योनिं कुर्वीत सुसमाहितः ॥ 23 ॥
4.142.m: Its three steps should be twelve finger-breadths wide; / and well-concentrated, he should fashion the vulva-shaped hearth of that same dimension.

4.142.s:
kuṃḍasya pūrvabhāge tu vediṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
caturhastāṃ samāṃ caiva hastamātrocchritaḥ nṛpa .. 24 ..
4.142.d:
कुंडस्य पूर्वभागे तु वेदिं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ॥
चतुर्हस्तां समां चैव हस्तमात्रोच्छ्रितः नृप ॥ 24 ॥
4.142.m: To the east of the sacrificial pit, the discerning [priest] should make an altar, / four cubits [wide], level, and one cubit high, O king.

4.142.s: sthānaṃ tatsarvabhūtānāṃ kuryādyatnena buddhimān .. 25 ..
4.142.d: स्थानं तत्सर्वभूतानां कुर्याद्यत्नेन बुद्धिमान् ॥ 25 ॥
4.142.m: The wise [priest] should diligently prepare that place for all the beings.

4.142.s:
udalipya tato bhūmiṃ maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ ..
vinyasetkalaśāṃstatra jalapūrṇāṃścaturdaśa .. 26 ..
4.142.d:
उदलिप्य ततो भूमिं मंडपस्य समीपतः ॥
विन्यसेत्कलशांस्तत्र जलपूर्णांश्चतुर्दश ॥ 26 ॥
4.142.m: Then, having smeared the ground in the vicinity of the pavilion, / he should place there fourteen water pots filled with water,

4.142.s:
aśvatthaplakṣacūtādyaiḥ pallavairupaśobhitān..
vitānamupariṣṭācca maṃḍapasya prakalpayet .. 27 ..
4.142.d:
अश्वत्थप्लक्षचूताद्यैः पल्लवैरुपशोभितान्॥
वितानमुपरिष्टाच्च मंडपस्य प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.142.m: adorned with sprouts of aśvattha, plakṣa, mango, and other [trees]. / And he should arrange a canopy over the pavilion.

4.142.s:
sthāpayeddikṣu sarvāsu toraṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraiḥ purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 28 ..
4.142.d:
स्थापयेद्दिक्षु सर्वासु तोरणानि विचक्षणः ॥
एवं संभृतसंभारैः पुरोधाः सुसमाहितः ॥ 28 ॥
4.142.m: In all the directions, the discerning [priest] should erect archways. / With the materials thus assembled, the family priest, well-concentrated,

4.142.s:
puṇyāhajayaghoṣeṇa homakarma samārabhet ..
sthāpayitvā surānvedyāṃ vakṣyamāṇānariṃdama .. 29 ..
4.142.d:
पुण्याहजयघोषेण होमकर्म समारभेत् ॥
स्थापयित्वा सुरान्वेद्यां वक्ष्यमाणानरिंदम ॥ 29 ॥
4.142.m: should begin the work of oblation with the proclamation of 'auspicious day' and cries of victory, / having established the gods on the altar, as will be mentioned, O crusher of foes:

4.142.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvabhāge tu madhye devaṃ janārdanam..
paścime tu tathā rudraṃ vasūnuttaratastathā .. 4.142.30 ..
4.142.d:
ब्राह्मणं पूर्वभागे तु मध्ये देवं जनार्दनम्॥
पश्चिमे तु तथा रुद्रं वसूनुत्तरतस्तथा ॥ 4.142.30 ॥
4.142.m: Brahmā in the eastern part, and in the middle Lord Janārdana; / Rudra in the west, and likewise the Vasus in the north;

4.142.s:
aiśānyāṃ ca grahānsarvānāgneyyāṃ marutastathā ..
vāyuṃ saumyāṃ tathaiśānyāṃ lokapālānkrameṇa tu .. 31 ..
4.142.d:
ऐशान्यां च ग्रहान्सर्वानाग्नेय्यां मरुतस्तथा ॥
वायुं सौम्यां तथैशान्यां लोकपालान्क्रमेण तु ॥ 31 ॥
4.142.m: and all the planets in the north-east, the Maruts in the south-east, / Vāyu in the north, and in the north-east the world protectors, in due order.

4.142.s:
evaṃ saṃsthāpya vibudhānyathāsthānaṃ nṛpottama ..
pūjayedvidhivadvastragandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 32 ..
4.142.d:
एवं संस्थाप्य विबुधान्यथास्थानं नृपोत्तम ॥
पूजयेद्विधिवद्वस्त्रगन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 32 ॥
4.142.m: Having thus established the gods in their respective places, O best of kings, / he should worship them according to rule with garments, perfumes, garlands, and unguents,

4.142.s:
vedoktamaṃtraistalliṅgaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. ..
ādityā vasavo rudrā lokapālāstathā grahāḥ .. 33 ..
4.142.d:
वेदोक्तमंत्रैस्तल्लिङ्गैः पुराणोक्तैः पृथक्पृथक् ॥ ॥
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा लोकपालास्तथा ग्रहाः ॥ 33 ॥
4.142.m: with the mantras mentioned in the Vedas bearing their characteristics, and with those spoken in the Purāṇas, individually: / 'The Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the world protectors, and the planets,

4.142.s:
brahmā janārdanaścaiva śūlapāṇirbhagākṣihā ..
atra saṃnihitāḥ sarve bhavaṃtu sukhabhāginaḥ .. 34 ..
4.142.d:
ब्रह्मा जनार्दनश्चैव शूलपाणिर्भगाक्षिहा ॥
अत्र संनिहिताः सर्वे भवंतु सुखभागिनः ॥ 34 ॥
4.142.m: Brahmā, Janārdana, and the spear-bearing destroyer of Bhaga's eyes— / may they all be present here and partake of joy!

4.142.s:
pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu sarvetra mayā bhaktyopapāditām ..
kurvaṃtu ca śubhaṃ sarve yajñakarma samāhitāḥ .. 35 ..
4.142.d:
पूजां गृह्णंतु सर्वेत्र मया भक्त्योपपादिताम् ॥
कुर्वंतु च शुभं सर्वे यज्ञकर्म समाहिताः ॥ 35 ॥
4.142.m: May all accept the worship offered here by me with devotion, / and, concentrated in mind, may all bring good fortune to the sacrificial rite!'

4.142.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tāndevānyatnena śuddhadhīḥ..
naivedyairvividhairbhakṣyaiḥ phalaiḥ patraistathaiva ca .. 36 ..
4.142.d:
एवं संपूजयित्वा तान्देवान्यत्नेन शुद्धधीः॥
नैवेद्यैर्विविधैर्भक्ष्यैः फलैः पत्रैस्तथैव च ॥ 36 ॥
4.142.m: Having thus carefully worshipped those deities, with a pure mind, / with various food-offerings, eatables, fruits, and leaves,

4.142.s:
tatastu tairdvijaiḥ sārddhaṃ kuṃḍasya vidhipūrvakam ..
kuryātsaṃskārakaraṇaṃ yathoktaṃ vedacintakaiḥ .. 37 ..
4.142.d:
ततस्तु तैर्द्विजैः सार्द्धं कुंडस्य विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
कुर्यात्संस्कारकरणं यथोक्तं वेदचिन्तकैः ॥ 37 ॥
4.142.m: then, along with those twice-born, he should duly perform / the consecration of the sacrificial pit, as stated by those who contemplate the Veda.

4.142.s:
tataḥ samāhvayedvahniṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ ghṛtārciṣam ..
niyojayeddvijāṃstatra śatasaṃkhyānnṛpottama ..
alābhe tu bahūnā ca yathālābhaṃ niyojayet .. 38 ..
4.142.d:
ततः समाह्वयेद्वह्निं नाम्ना ख्यातं घृतार्चिषम् ॥
नियोजयेद्द्विजांस्तत्र शतसंख्यान्नृपोत्तम ॥
अलाभे तु बहूना च यथालाभं नियोजयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.142.m: Then he should invoke the fire known by name as Ghṛtārcis. / He should employ one hundred Brahmins there, O best of kings; / but if many are not to be found, he should employ as many as are available:

4.142.s:
vidyāvṛddhānvayovṛddhāngṛhasthānsaṃyatendriyān..
svakarmaniyatāñjñānaśīlāñchāntāndvijottamān .. 39 ..
4.142.d:
विद्यावृद्धान्वयोवृद्धान्गृहस्थान्संयतेन्द्रियान्॥
स्वकर्मनियताञ्ज्ञानशीलाञ्छान्तान्द्विजोत्तमान् ॥ 39 ॥
4.142.m: the best of the twice-born, advanced in learning, advanced in age, householders who have restrained their senses, / devoted to their own duties, possessing knowledge and good conduct, and tranquil.

4.142.s:
ciṃtayettatra deveśaṃ paṃcāsyaṃ nṛpa pāvakam ..
mukhāni tasya catvāri sapta jihvāśca pārthiva .. 4.142.40 ..
4.142.d:
चिंतयेत्तत्र देवेशं पंचास्यं नृप पावकम् ॥
मुखानि तस्य चत्वारि सप्त जिह्वाश्च पार्थिव ॥ 4.142.40 ॥
4.142.m: There he should meditate on the fire, the lord of gods, as having five faces, O king; / he has four faces and seven tongues, O ruler of the earth.

4.142.s:
ekajihvamathaikaṃ tu tatsmṛtaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
dhūmāyamāne mana vṛthā hotavyaṃ jvalite nale .. 41 ..
4.142.d:
एकजिह्वमथैकं तु तत्स्मृतं सर्वकामदम् ॥
धूमायमाने मन वृथा होतव्यं ज्वलिते नले ॥ 41 ॥
4.142.m: Or else he is remembered as having a single tongue, granting all desires. / An oblation should not be offered in smoke; it should be offered into blazing fire.

4.142.s:
ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāmukhairhomo yajurbhiścottarāmukhaiḥ.
sāmabhiḥ paścime kāryo'tharvabhirdakṣiṇāmukhaiḥ .. 42 ..
4.142.d:
ऋग्भिः पूर्वामुखैर्होमो यजुर्भिश्चोत्तरामुखैः।
सामभिः पश्चिमे कार्योऽथर्वभिर्दक्षिणामुखैः ॥ 42 ॥
4.142.m: The oblation is to be performed with Ṛg[veda verses] facing east, with Yajur[veda verses] facing north, / with Sāma[veda verses] in the west, and with Atharva[veda verses] facing south.

4.142.s:
āghārāvājya bhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
paritotha paristīrṇe kalpitai ca tathāsane .. 43 ..
4.142.d:
आघारावाज्य भागौ तु पूर्वं हुत्वा विचक्षणः ॥
परितोथ परिस्तीर्णे कल्पितै च तथासने ॥ 43 ॥
4.142.m: Having first offered the two āghāra and the two portions of clarified butter, the discerning [priest], / all around the strewn grass and upon the prepared seat,

4.142.s:
brahmāṇaṃ pūrvamapyetatsarvaṃ paścātsamācaret ..
homo vyāhṛtibhiścaiva sarvastatra vidhīyate .. 44 ..
4.142.d:
ब्रह्माणं पूर्वमप्येतत्सर्वं पश्चात्समाचरेत् ॥
होमो व्याहृतिभिश्चैव सर्वस्तत्र विधीयते ॥ 44 ॥
4.142.m: [having worshipped] Brahmā beforehand, should then perform all this. / And the entire oblation is prescribed to be made there with the vyāhṛtis.

4.142.s:
praṇavādibhistalliṃgaiḥ svāhākārāṃtayojitaiḥ..
juhuyātsarvadevānāṃ vedyāṃ ye copakalpitāḥ ..45..
4.142.d:
प्रणवादिभिस्तल्लिंगैः स्वाहाकारांतयोजितैः॥
जुहुयात्सर्वदेवानां वेद्यां ये चोपकल्पिताः ॥45॥
4.142.m: With [mantras] beginning with the syllable Oṃ, possessing their distinguishing marks, and joined with "svāhā" at the end, / one should offer oblations to all the gods who have been prepared on the altar.

4.142.s:
evaṃ prakalpaye dyajñaṃ koṭihomākhyamuttamam ..
tilāḥ kṛṣṇā ghṛtābhyaktāḥ kiñcidyavasamanvitāḥ .. 46 ..
4.142.d:
एवं प्रकल्पये द्यज्ञं कोटिहोमाख्यमुत्तमम् ॥
तिलाः कृष्णा घृताभ्यक्ताः किञ्चिद्यवसमन्विताः ॥ 46 ॥
4.142.m: Thus one should perform the supreme sacrifice called the Koṭihoma. / Black sesame seeds smeared with ghee, mixed with a little barley,

4.142.s:
hotavyāḥ koṭihome tu samidhaśca palāśajāḥ ..
pūrṇe pūrṇesahasre tu dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ śubhām ..
pañcame tanmukhe rājansarvakāmārthasiddhaye .. 47..
4.142.d:
होतव्याः कोटिहोमे तु समिधश्च पलाशजाः ॥
पूर्णे पूर्णेसहस्रे तु दद्यात्पूर्णाहुतिं शुभाम् ॥
पञ्चमे तन्मुखे राजन्सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये ॥ 47॥
4.142.m: and firewood born of the palāśa tree should be offered in the Koṭihoma. / At the completion of each thousand, one should offer an auspicious final oblation / into that fifth mouth, O king, for the attainment of all desired objects.

4.142.s:
pūrṇāhutyaḥ samākhyātāḥ koṭihome narādhipa ..
sahasrāṇi nṛpaśreṣṭha daśa śāstraviśāradaiḥ .. 48 ..
4.142.d:
पूर्णाहुत्यः समाख्याताः कोटिहोमे नराधिप ॥
सहस्राणि नृपश्रेष्ठ दश शास्त्रविशारदैः ॥ 48 ॥
4.142.m: Ten thousand final oblations in the Koṭihoma / are proclaimed by those learned in the scriptures, O best of kings, O ruler of men.

4.142.s:
prāraṃbhadinamārabhya brāhmaṇairbrahmavādibhiḥ ..
bhāvyaṃ sayajamānaistu athavā sapurohitaiḥ .. 49 ..
4.142.d:
प्रारंभदिनमारभ्य ब्राह्मणैर्ब्रह्मवादिभिः ॥
भाव्यं सयजमानैस्तु अथवा सपुरोहितैः ॥ 49 ॥
4.142.m: From the day of commencement, the brāhmaṇas who expound the Veda / should abide [in purity] together with the sacrificers or with the family priests.

4.142.s:
krodhalobhādayo doṣā varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ..
yajamānena rājendra savargakāmānabhīpsitā .. 4.142.50 ..
4.142.d:
क्रोधलोभादयो दोषा वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः ॥
यजमानेन राजेन्द्र सवर्गकामानभीप्सिता ॥ 4.142.50 ॥
4.142.m: Faults such as anger and greed must be diligently avoided / by the sacrificer, O king of kings, who desires all objects of wish.

4.142.s:
.. saṃvaraṇa uvāca .. ..
bahutvātkarmaṇo brahmankoṭi homaḥ suduṣkaraḥ ..
kālena mahatā caiva śakyaḥ prāptuṃ kathaṃcana .. 51 ..
4.142.d:
॥ संवरण उवाच ॥ ॥
बहुत्वात्कर्मणो ब्रह्मन्कोटि होमः सुदुष्करः ॥
कालेन महता चैव शक्यः प्राप्तुं कथंचन ॥ 51 ॥
4.142.m: Saṃvaraṇa said: / O brāhmaṇa, on account of the vastness of the ritual, the Koṭihoma is very difficult to perform; / and it can scarcely be accomplished, even in a great length of time.

4.142.s:
niyamādbrahmacaryādvā duṣkaro hīti me matiḥ ..
nirodho'tra brāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛśayyādiṣu duṣkaraḥ ..52..
4.142.d:
नियमाद्ब्रह्मचर्याद्वा दुष्करो हीति मे मतिः ॥
निरोधोऽत्र ब्राह्मणानां भृशय्यादिषु दुष्करः ॥52॥
4.142.m: Because of the observances or celibacy, it is indeed difficult to perform—such is my opinion. / The restraint of the brāhmaṇas here in sleeping on the ground and the like is difficult.

4.142.s:
kāryādgurutayā yasmātparvakālādyapekṣayā ..
etadvijñāyate brahmanyadi śāstreṣu kathyate ..
koṭihomasya saṃkṣepaṃ vada me brahma saṃbhava .. 53 ..
4.142.d:
कार्याद्गुरुतया यस्मात्पर्वकालाद्यपेक्षया ॥
एतद्विज्ञायते ब्रह्मन्यदि शास्त्रेषु कथ्यते ॥
कोटिहोमस्य संक्षेपं वद मे ब्रह्म संभव ॥ 53 ॥
4.142.m: Since, on account of the weight of the task, [it depends] on seasonal moments and the like, / if this is explained in the scriptures, O brāhmaṇa, and is understood, / tell me the abridgement of the Koṭihoma, O son of Brahmā.

4.142.s:
.. sanatkumāra uvāca .. ..
śatānano daśamukho dvimukhaikamukhastathā ..
caturvidho mahārāja koṭihomo vidhīyate .. 54 ..
4.142.d:
॥ सनत्कुमार उवाच ॥ ॥
शताननो दशमुखो द्विमुखैकमुखस्तथा ॥
चतुर्विधो महाराज कोटिहोमो विधीयते ॥ 54 ॥
4.142.m: Sanatkumāra said: / With a hundred faces, with ten faces, with two faces, and with one face— / fourfold, O great king, is the Koṭihoma prescribed.

4.142.s:
kāryasya gurutāṃ jñātvā naiva kuryādaparvaṇi ..
yathā saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomastathā śṛṇu .. 55 ..
4.142.d:
कार्यस्य गुरुतां ज्ञात्वा नैव कुर्यादपर्वणि ॥
यथा संक्षेपतः कार्यः कोटिहोमस्तथा शृणु ॥ 55 ॥
4.142.m: Recognizing the gravity of the task, one must not perform it on an inauspicious lunar occasion. / Hear how the Koṭihoma is to be performed in brief:

4.142.s:
kṛtvā kuṃḍaśataṃ divyaṃ yathoktaṃ hasta saṃmitam ..
ekaikasmiṃstataḥ kuṃḍe śataṃ viprānniyojayet .. 56 ..
4.142.d:
कृत्वा कुंडशतं दिव्यं यथोक्तं हस्त संमितम् ॥
एकैकस्मिंस्ततः कुंडे शतं विप्रान्नियोजयेत् ॥ 56 ॥
4.142.m: Having made a hundred divine sacrificial pits according to instruction, measuring one cubit, / one should then assign a hundred vipras to each sacrificial pit.

4.142.s:
sadyaḥ pakṣe tu viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ parikīrtitam ..
ekasthānapraṇītegnau sarvataḥ paribhāvite .. 57 ..
4.142.d:
सद्यः पक्षे तु विप्राणां सहस्रं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
एकस्थानप्रणीतेग्नौ सर्वतः परिभाविते ॥ 57 ॥
4.142.m: In the immediate procedure, a thousand vipras are proclaimed. / When the fire has been brought from one place and consecrated all around,

4.142.s:
homaṃ kuryurdvijāḥ sarve kuṇḍe kuṇḍe yathoditam ..
yathā kuṃḍabahutve'pi rājasūye mahākratau .. 58 ..
4.142.d:
होमं कुर्युर्द्विजाः सर्वे कुण्डे कुण्डे यथोदितम् ॥
यथा कुंडबहुत्वेऽपि राजसूये महाक्रतौ ॥ 58 ॥
4.142.m: all the twice-born should make offerings in pit after pit, as declared, / just as, even though there are many sacrificial pits in the great Rājasūya sacrifice,

4.142.s:
na ca vahnibahutvaṃ syāttatra yajñe vidhīyate ..
tathā kuṃḍaśate'pyatra ghṛtārciṣi vitānite .. 59 ..
4.142.d:
न च वह्निबहुत्वं स्यात्तत्र यज्ञे विधीयते ॥
तथा कुंडशतेऽप्यत्र घृतार्चिषि वितानिते ॥ 59 ॥
4.142.m: there is no multiplicity of fires prescribed in that sacrifice; / so here too, even though there are a hundred sacrificial pits when the fire fed by ghee is spread,

4.142.s:
eka eva bhavedyajñaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ ..
evaṃ yatkriyate kṣipraṃ vyākulaiḥ kāryagauravāt ..
śatānanaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ .. 4.142.60 ..
4.142.d:
एक एव भवेद्यज्ञः कोटिहोमो न संशयः ॥
एवं यत्क्रियते क्षिप्रं व्याकुलैः कार्यगौरवात् ॥
शताननः स विज्ञेयः कोटिहोमो न संशयः ॥ 4.142.60 ॥
4.142.m: the sacrifice, the Koṭihoma, remains only one, without doubt. / Thus, what is done swiftly by those anxious due to the gravity of the task, / is to be known as the hundred-faced Koṭihoma, without doubt.

4.142.s:
svalpairahobhiḥ kāryaḥ syādvarṣākālādike'pi vā ..
tadā daśaguṇaḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vijānatā .. 61 ..
4.142.d:
स्वल्पैरहोभिः कार्यः स्याद्वर्षाकालादिकेऽपि वा ॥
तदा दशगुणः कार्यः कोटिहोमो विजानता ॥ 61 ॥
4.142.m: If it must be done in a few days, or during the rainy season and the like, / then the tenfold Koṭihoma should be performed by the wise man.

4.142.s:
viprāṇāṃ dve śate tatra suvibhajya niyojayet ..
te'pi vijñānaśīlāḥ syurvratavaṃto jitendriyāḥ .. 62 ..
4.142.d:
विप्राणां द्वे शते तत्र सुविभज्य नियोजयेत् ॥
तेऽपि विज्ञानशीलाः स्युर्व्रतवंतो जितेन्द्रियाः ॥ 62 ॥
4.142.m: Two hundred vipras should be appointed there, well apportioned; / they too should be men of knowledge, keeping vows, with subdued senses.

4.142.s:
bhūpa kuṃḍadvayaṃ kṛtvā vibhajya ca vibhāvasum ..
homaṃ kuryurdvijā bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtya vidhipūrvakam .. 63 ..
4.142.d:
भूप कुंडद्वयं कृत्वा विभज्य च विभावसुम् ॥
होमं कुर्युर्द्विजा भूयः संस्कृत्य विधिपूर्वकम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.142.m: Having made two sacrificial pits, O king, and having divided the fire, / the twice-born should repeatedly offer oblations after sanctifying [it] according to rule.

4.142.s:
śataṃ tatra niyojyaṃ syādviprāṇāṃ pravibhajya vai ..
māse vātha dvimāse vā yathākāle hyupasthite .. 64 ..
4.142.d:
शतं तत्र नियोज्यं स्याद्विप्राणां प्रविभज्य वै ॥
मासे वाथ द्विमासे वा यथाकाले ह्युपस्थिते ॥ 64 ॥
4.142.m: A hundred vipras are to be appointed there, properly distributed, / in one month or in two months, when the proper time has arrived.

4.142.s: evaṃ ca dvimukhaṃ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vicakṣaṇaiḥ .. 65 ..
4.142.d: एवं च द्विमुखं कार्यः कोटिहोमो विचक्षणैः ॥ 65 ॥
4.142.m: And in this way the two-faced Koṭihoma should be performed by the discerning.

4.142.s:
yadā tu svecchayā yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ samāpayet ..
kālena bahudhā rājaṃstadā caikamukho bhavet .. 66 ..
4.142.d:
यदा तु स्वेच्छया यज्ञं यजमानः समापयेत् ॥
कालेन बहुधा राजंस्तदा चैकमुखो भवेत् ॥ 66 ॥
4.142.m: When, however, the sacrificer concludes the sacrifice at his own will / over a long period of time in many ways, O king, it becomes one-faced.

4.142.s:
ekakuṃḍasthito vahnirekacittaiḥ samāhitaiḥ ..
yathālābha sthitairviprairjñānaśīlairvicakṣaṇaiḥ ..67..
4.142.d:
एककुंडस्थितो वह्निरेकचित्तैः समाहितैः ॥
यथालाभ स्थितैर्विप्रैर्ज्ञानशीलैर्विचक्षणैः ॥67॥
4.142.m: The fire resides in a single sacrificial pit; [the offerings are made] with single-mindedness and concentration / by discerning vipras endowed with wisdom, present as available.

4.142.s:
na saṃkhyāniyamaścātra brāhmaṇānāṃ narottama ..
na kālaniyamaścaiva svecchāyajñaḥ sa ucyate .. 68 ..
4.142.d:
न संख्यानियमश्चात्र ब्राह्मणानां नरोत्तम ॥
न कालनियमश्चैव स्वेच्छायज्ञः स उच्यते ॥ 68 ॥
4.142.m: Here there is no fixed rule for the number of brāhmaṇas, O best of men, / nor is there a fixed rule for time; that is called a sacrifice at one's own will.

4.142.s:
āvṛttyā sarvakāmasya cāturmāsyānukarmavat ..
tadaprasaktau kartavyo yajño'yaṃ sārvakālikaḥ .. 69 ..
4.142.d:
आवृत्त्या सर्वकामस्य चातुर्मास्यानुकर्मवत् ॥
तदप्रसक्तौ कर्तव्यो यज्ञोऽयं सार्वकालिकः ॥ 69 ॥
4.142.m: Through repetition it yields all desires, like the rite following the Cāturmāsya. / When that [other method] is impracticable, this universal-time sacrifice should be performed.

4.142.s:
ayamekamukho rājankālena bahunā bhavet ..
bahuvighnaśca kālena tasmātsaṃkṣepamācaret .. 4.142.70 ..
4.142.d:
अयमेकमुखो राजन्कालेन बहुना भवेत् ॥
बहुविघ्नश्च कालेन तस्मात्संक्षेपमाचरेत् ॥ 4.142.70 ॥
4.142.m: This one-faced one, O king, takes a long time, / and with time there are many obstacles; therefore one should practice the abridged [form].

4.142.s:
yato hi cittavittādyamāyuścaivāsthiraṃ sadā ..
ataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ praśasyate .. 71 ..
4.142.d:
यतो हि चित्तवित्ताद्यमायुश्चैवास्थिरं सदा ॥
अतः संक्षेपतः कार्यं धर्मकार्यं प्रशस्यते ॥ 71 ॥
4.142.m: For mind, wealth, and the like, as well as life itself, are always unstable; / therefore an auspicious religious duty is praised when performed in abridged form.

4.142.s:
tataḥ samāpte yajñe tu kārayetsumahotsavam ..
śaṃkhatūryaninādena brahmaghoṣasvanena ca .. 72 ..
4.142.d:
ततः समाप्ते यज्ञे तु कारयेत्सुमहोत्सवम् ॥
शंखतूर्यनिनादेन ब्रह्मघोषस्वनेन च ॥ 72 ॥
4.142.m: Then, when the sacrifice has concluded, he should cause a great festival to be held, / with the sounding of conches and trumpets, and with the sound of Vedic recitation.

4.142.s:
tatastu dīkṣayedvinprānhotṝṃśca śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
niṣkaiśca kaṃkaṇaiścaiva kuṇḍalairvividhairnṛpa .. 73 ..
4.142.d:
ततस्तु दीक्षयेद्विन्प्रान्होतॄंश्च श्रद्धयान्वितः ॥
निष्कैश्च कंकणैश्चैव कुण्डलैर्विविधैर्नृप ॥ 73 ॥
4.142.m: Then, filled with faith, he should reward the vipras and the hotṛ priests, / O king, with gold coins, bracelets, and various earrings.

4.142.s:
gośataṃ caiva dātavyamaśvānāṃ ca śataṃ tadā ..
sahasraṃ ca suvarṇasya sarveṣāmapi dāpayet .. 74 ..
4.142.d:
गोशतं चैव दातव्यमश्वानां च शतं तदा ॥
सहस्रं च सुवर्णस्य सर्वेषामपि दापयेत् ॥ 74 ॥
4.142.m: A hundred cows and a hundred horses should then be given, / and he should have a thousand [measures] of gold given to all of them.

4.142.s:
grāmairgajai rathairaśvaiḥ pūjayecca purohitam ..
dīnāndhakṛpaṇānsarvānvastrādyaiścāpi pūjayet .. 79 ..
4.142.d:
ग्रामैर्गजै रथैरश्वैः पूजयेच्च पुरोहितम् ॥
दीनान्धकृपणान्सर्वान्वस्त्राद्यैश्चापि पूजयेत् ॥ 79 ॥
4.142.m: He should honor the family priest with villages, elephants, chariots, and horses; / and he should honor all the poor, the blind, and the destitute with garments and the like.

4.142.s:
tataścāvabhṛthaṃ snāyāttairghaṭaiḥ pūrvakalpitaiḥ ..
lakṣahomoktamaṃtreṇa sadā vijayakāriṇā .. 76 ..
4.142.d:
ततश्चावभृथं स्नायात्तैर्घटैः पूर्वकल्पितैः ॥
लक्षहोमोक्तमंत्रेण सदा विजयकारिणा ॥ 76 ॥
4.142.m: Then he should bathe in the final ablution with those jars prepared beforehand, / using the mantra declared for the Lakṣahoma, which always produces victory.

4.142.s:
evaṃ samāpayedyastu koṭihomamakhaṃ śubham ..
tasyārogyaṃ vittaputrarāṣṭravṛddhistathaiva ca .. 77 ..
4.142.d:
एवं समापयेद्यस्तु कोटिहोममखं शुभम् ॥
तस्यारोग्यं वित्तपुत्रराष्ट्रवृद्धिस्तथैव च ॥ 77 ॥
4.142.m: Whoever concludes the auspicious Koṭihoma sacrifice in this way, / for him there is health, increase of wealth, sons, and kingdom,

4.142.s:
sarvapāpakṣayaścaiva jāyate nṛpasattama ..
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ caiva utpātabhayameva ca .. 78 ..
4.142.d:
सर्वपापक्षयश्चैव जायते नृपसत्तम ॥
अनावृष्टिभयं चैव उत्पातभयमेव च ॥ 78 ॥
4.142.m: and the destruction of all sins occurs, O best of kings. / Fear of drought and fear of portents,

4.142.s:
durbhikṣaṃ grahapīḍā ca praśamaṃ yāti bhūtale ..
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
sanatkumāramuninā pārthivāya niveditum .. 79 ..
4.142.d:
दुर्भिक्षं ग्रहपीडा च प्रशमं याति भूतले ॥
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥
सनत्कुमारमुनिना पार्थिवाय निवेदितुम् ॥ 79 ॥
4.142.m: famine, and the affliction caused by planets are pacified on the earth. / This merit, which removes sins and bestows the fruit of all desires, / has been declared to the king by the sage Sanatkumāra.

4.142.s:
sarvopasargaśamanaṃ bhavane vane vā ye kārayanti manujā nṛpakoṭihomam ..
bhogānavāpya manasobhimatānprakāmaṃ te yāṃti śakrasadanaṃ suviśuddhasattvāḥ .. 4.142.80 .. ..

4.142.d:
सर्वोपसर्गशमनं भवने वने वा ये कारयन्ति मनुजा नृपकोटिहोमम् ॥
भोगानवाप्य मनसोभिमतान्प्रकामं ते यांति शक्रसदनं सुविशुद्धसत्त्वाः ॥ 4.142.80 ॥ ॥
महाशान्तिविधिवर्णनम्
4.142.m:
Those men who cause the king's Koṭihoma—which quells all afflictions—to be performed in the palace or in the forest, / having attained at will the pleasures desired by their mind, go with completely purified nature to the abode of Śakra.
